mentions.name: LingoFreq
mentions.description: This language-learning tool builds practice audio from language-specific high-frequency word lists: it generates example sentences by theme or topic, translates the words and phrases into English, Spanish, and Chinese, and vocalizes each phrase with text-to-speech. Learners set a frequency-range window to practice and the tool plays the ordered audio files within that range, so they can study while doing dishes, at the gym, or before bed.
mentions.source_excerpt: (2) PROJECT "LINGOFREQ" - Language learning tool. Uses language-specific high-frequency word lists. Generates example sentences according to a theme/topic. Translates the word & example phrases to English / Spanish / Chinese. Uses Text-to-speech to vocalize the phrases into each language.
